incidents.name: GoldReserve profit claim keyed on current NFT balance
incidents.notes: GoldReserve records claimed profit per address while entitlement is computed from the caller's current ERC1155 balance, so the attacker minted NFTs after a profit deposit and moved the same NFTs through fresh addresses to claim the same profit repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x7c77576a2b48504EBD9fF0810D799651f68742d3 created 2024-12-27T15:13:06Z by 0xd544884544c4c828921ca33d79e45504d574cb12, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xfbe2cf822e1361fb74421e2a0bd9844a48932ce2; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 12.74 BNB x $672.170514/BNB at the incident timestamp 1738416333 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $8,564.
